title: Ordinary and integral image formulas for the intrinsic scalar compositor
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, an arbitrary scheme $Y$, and finite coefficient subfields $E\le L\le M$ of $\Omega$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers, def-weil-algebraic-closure, def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Use the specified small coefficient models and their conjugated inclusions [lem-route-coefficient-inclusion-laws]; the universe of $Y$ is independent of that of $\Omega$. For each $F$ let $R_F=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,Y}$ be the completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], let $\mathcal D_F=D(\operatorname{Mod}(R_F))$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $I_F:\mathcal I_F\hookrightarrow\mathcal D_F$ be the full intrinsic integral constructible inclusion [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], with inherited coherent shifts and inclusion comparison $\beta_{F,n,Z}:I_F(Z[n])\cong(I_F Z)[n]$ [lem-weil-integral-constructible-triangulated]. It is fully faithful.

Write $U_{FL}:\mathcal I_F\to\mathcal I_L$ for the actual restricted completed scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension] with characteristic proof parameter zero, and $Q_F:\mathcal I_F\to C_F=\mathcal I_F[1/\varpi_F]$ for raw rationalization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Use the actual rational transitions $T_{FL}$ and normalized integral shifts $\tau_{FL,n}$ of [lem-general-algebraically-closed-coefficient-stages]. Let $\chi_{FL}:C_{FL}^{\mathrm{ord}}I_F\cong I_LU_{FL}$ be the specified sfIntegralOrdinaryComparison [def-zl-normalized-integral-scalar-comparison], where $C_{FL}^{\mathrm{ord}}$ is ordinary derived extension of $R_F\to R_L$. Ordinary extension $M\mapsto M\otimes_{R_F}R_L$ on module sheaves (the change of rings of [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]) is additive and exact, and $C_{FL}^{\mathrm{ord}}$ is its exact termwise induced derived functor [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. Its associator $\alpha:C_{LM}^{\mathrm{ord}}C_{EL}^{\mathrm{ord}}\cong C_{EM}^{\mathrm{ord}}$ is the inverse exact-derived composition comparison followed by the derived image of ordinary balanced tensor multiplication; on ordinary local tensor generators this multiplication is $c\otimes(b\otimes x)\mapsto c\,j(b)\otimes x$, where $j:R_L\to R_M$ is the coefficient map.

The following are identities for the specified constructions, with composition read right to left. If $b:U_{LM}U_{EL}\cong U_{EM}$ is the specified sfIntegralScalarComp [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition], followed by the coefficient-inclusion composition equality, then
$$I_M(b_K)=\chi_{EM,K}\circ\alpha_{I_EK}\circ C_{LM}^{\mathrm{ord}}(\chi_{EL,K}^{-1})\circ\chi_{LM,U_{EL}K}^{-1}.$$
Writing $h_{FL,n,K}:C_{FL}^{\mathrm{ord}}I_F(K[n])\cong(C_{FL}^{\mathrm{ord}}I_FK)[n]$ for the composite ordinary derived and inclusion comparison, the prescribed integral shift satisfies
$$\beta_{L,n,U_{FL}K}\circ I_L(\tau_{FL,n,K})=\chi_{FL,K}[n]\circ h_{FL,n,K}\circ\chi_{FL,K[n]}^{-1}.$$
Finally, the specified rational associator $a_{ELM}$ of [lem-general-algebraically-closed-coefficient-stages] has
$$a_{ELM,Q_EK}=Q_M(b_K).$$
These identities are interpreted after the actual endpoint equalities for the rational functors and for the composed coefficient inclusions, equivalently by heterogeneous equality. They hold for all integral objects $K$, for every $n\in\mathbf Z$, and also when indices repeat. There is no finite-field datum, geometric base-field, invertibility, dimension or Noetherian assumption on $Y$, and no idempotent completion.
